title: Neow's Bones
description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Neow Relics[/gold]. Add [blue]1[/blue] random [red]Curse[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Upon pickup, this relic offers a selection of random relics from Neow's valid options and adds random curses to the player's deck. The relic excludes itself from the valid relics pool to prevent infinite loops.
